## Idea / Motivation

What problem is being solved, and why.

## What Changed

Concise summary of the architectural and code changes.

## How It Was Tested

Exact commands (`make test`, `make lint`), the unit tests added, mock (`stratatest`) or live repro
steps, and the observed output.

## Before vs. After Results

Measured latency, memory/VRAM, token reuse, file sizes, saves skipped — before and after. Write
"behavior only, no measurements" when the change has no measurable effect.
